video_title: Dinners with DeMar - Ep. 6: Tiffany Haddish

quotes.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
quotes.summary_phrase: Tiffany Haddish on DeMar DeRozan's community investment in South Central
quotes.excerpt: When I started hearing about you buying up land in South Central... I was even more proud.

text_blocks.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
text_blocks.text: When I started hearing about you buying up land in South Central, like you bought the spot on Crenshaw, and I'm like, oh, we in competition now. I was even more proud because it's like you didn't forget where you came from and you're like, okay, I'm going to have ownership in my community.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: To your point with that, it's like me just remembering what I came from goes back to that time when I was young, knowing the aggression, the pain, the frustration that we carry being kids.

quotes.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
quotes.summary_phrase: Tiffany Haddish on the importance of property ownership in the community
quotes.excerpt: You can't bang over here unless you own something over here. Like you got a deed, nigga?

text_blocks.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
text_blocks.text: If you got this much money and you're saying this is your block, you don't own anything on this street. This really ain't your block. This is Mr. Weinstein's block. This is Mr. Gostein's block. This is not your block. And I just feel like if we can be more of an example like, you can't bang over here unless you own something over here. Like you got a deed, nigga?

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: To your point with that, it's like me just remembering what I came from goes back to that time when I was young, knowing the aggression, the pain, the frustration that we carry being kids.

quotes.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
quotes.summary_phrase: Tiffany Haddish on the lack of investment in the Black community
quotes.excerpt: This is why our community is so bad and this is why the kids are hurting each other.

text_blocks.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
text_blocks.text: I started seeing like, this is why our community is so bad and this is why the kids are hurting each other because there's nobody investing that's actually here. There's nobody, they're not seeing somebody like flourish here. They see like a little bit of them and then they go away and then they never get to see it no more.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: I wanted to be an example. I want to do something better. I want to do something different and think outside of the box with what everybody else is doing.

quotes.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
quotes.summary_phrase: Tiffany Haddish on the benefits of investing in the community
quotes.excerpt: If I stay and I start investing, buying land, buying properties, then I can rent them out.

text_blocks.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
text_blocks.text: If I stay, first of all, the police going to come quicker because they know Tiffany Haddish is in the community. They, if I stay and I start investing, buying land, buying properties, then I can rent them out to people that I know needed and just need the extra boost. Also, I can rent it to organizations that help, like I was in foster care, so I'm very much about protecting our foster youth.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: I'm more paranoid living in nice places than I was living in the hood. It's like a trauma that I grew up in.

quotes.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
quotes.summary_phrase: Tiffany Haddish on the importance of showing up for the community
quotes.excerpt: Nipsey was big on that. And I used to be on his head about it like, hey.

text_blocks.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
text_blocks.text: Nipsey was big on that. And I used to be on his head about it like, hey, you got to make sure you show, like show up. Be out here. Let them know that you're doing stuff out here that you own this, that you're doing that because that's going to change some young person's mind frame.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: The more you see and have that belief, it's motivating. That's the only way we motivate each other more than anything.
